sections.label: CPF Amendment Bill 2021
sections.summary: The CPF (Amendment) Bill 2021 is linked to the Retirement and Re-employment (Amendment) Bill 2021, whose amendments were explained in the prior debate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The CPF (Amendment) Bill 2021 is linked to the previous Bill in our Order Paper – Retirement and Re-employment (Amendment) Bill 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: In the debate we have just had on that Bill, I have explained the amendments proposed in both Bills.
